method: Inspected every full Poppler-rendered PNG page at110dpi through image viewing. Checked crop scale, row identities, L/R labels, changed coordinates, deletion panels, table readability, uncertainty language and scope against the accepted ledger. Confirmed PDF bytes, SHA256 and page count with pypdf. Text extraction was not a substitute for visual inspection.

page_checks.finding: Cover correctly distinguishes three coordinate-amended rows, five explicit exclusions, zero training changes and one inherited pending request. Counts and R37-before-deletion identity convention agree with the accepted ledger.

new_000008:7 bottom33 to23 is correctly overlaid. L1221,20 is unchanged. Text explains the sloping visible extent rather than snapping the box to the point, and rejects the taller predicted box as ground truth.

new_000007:47 top388 to385 agrees with overlays and table. Both observed points stay fixed; the explicit PR121 p57 cue is separated from PR123 p45/p57. No predicted xmin or displaced point is substituted.

Both thin-region exclusions 086:57 and088:57 have readable before/after crops at the same scale within each case. After panels remove only the selected row. Exclusion is not presented as proof of background or model recovery.

Image-boundary exclusions 053:1 and010:30 are correctly named by R37 row identity. After panels contain no selected-row overlay. Captioned shifts old053:2 to current1 and old010:31-34 to30-33 are correct; high containment is not claimed as proof of duplication.

limitations: Soft original boundaries support approximate2px visual ambiguity, not subpixel physical certainty.
Five removals are explicit case-specific user exclusions; this document does not certify them all as duplicate annotations or background.
